title: 直壁两点停顿
description: 彩铅描绘双手稳握大点、两脚清楚踏点的低位停顿。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: An original colored-pencil scene shows a fictional adult resting briefly on a compact vertical bouldering route. Both hands hold broad orange jugs, the arms are relaxed rather than strained, and both shoes press positive footholds only a small step above the thick crash mat. The climber looks sideways toward the next nearby hold, with a calm adult expression and naturally sized head. Compose a frontal medium-wide view that shows all contact points and empty landing space. Use layered indigo pencil shadows, warm paper grain, and muted cream wall surfaces. The figure wears opaque practical climbing clothes. Exclude captions, logos, high exposure, leaps, and spectators beneath the route.
